Community Plan Tracker

For the outreach team. Students are lost between their first video and lesson 5. The plan invites plan holders who aren't in their city group chat into it during week one, and tests that with a randomized pilot. Start with today's list, then check whether it's working.

Is it working · pilot readout

Treatment vs control

Intent-to-treat: everyone assigned to outreach vs everyone in control, whether or not they replied or joined. Randomized 50/50 at entry.

Smallest lift the pilot can detect

Percentage points. α = 0.05 two-sided, 80% power, 50/50 split, lowest full month of volume.

A 3-month pilot on the segment only detects a large effect. Widening to all first-video students not in the chat is the recommended design, with plan holders pre-registered as the main subgroup.

Owners and cadence are in Next steps.
